youtube.title: Round badge, curved words, every letter right: a run-club patch made with funkbox
youtube.description:
Round badge. Curved words. Every letter right.
The same two lines, set straight, then bent along the ring with arched text, and the text audit still checks every string exactly.
Fictional club, made for this demo.
Free, open source, runs locally: https://github.com/IsraelWebDev/funkbox
Made with funkbox.

x.text:
Round badge. Curved words. Every letter right.

In IsraelWebDev/funkbox a poster's text can bend along an arc around a badge's ring, and the text audit still checks every string exactly. Free, open source, runs locally.
